stem.text: What is a statement of the principle of conservation of momentum?

A.text: A force is equal to the rate of change of momentum of the body upon which it acts.

B.text: In a perfectly elastic collision, the relative momentum of the bodies before impact is equal to their relative momentum after impact.

C.text: The momentum of a body is the product of the mass of the body and its velocity.

D.text: The total momentum of a system of interacting bodies remains constant, providing no resultant external force acts on the system.
